description: The Chinese Electric Vehicle Policy Database publishes 7,300 records of national, provincial and municipal EV policies issued from 2000 through 2023. Its Figshare deposit provides Chinese and English versions, an XLSX codebook and a policy archive under CC BY 4.0. Fields describe policy goals, instruments, EV specificity, issuing authority and supply-chain stage. A transport modeller could code policy adoption or charger-rollout scenarios from these records, then test power-network capacity with a separate model such as model-pypsa. The data are policy metadata and annotations, not a measured series of charger installations or EV trips. The team used rules, manual checks and language-model assistance to classify documents, so annotation error and changes in policy interpretation remain possible. The English titles include machine translation and the underlying text links may have separate access terms. I read the own Figshare metadata and file manifest but did not download the archives or inspect individual policy documents. The round-one candidates were article-title hits rejected in unrelated sectors.
